svg.aria-label: 01 Campus, my core project: a site and an app for one study group that lives on the group leader's own computer. 193 Java classes, 169 UI components, 108 test files, 37 migrations, 31 versions, v1.0.2 release.
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: 01 Campus, my core project: a site and an app for one study group that lives on the group leader's own computer. 193 Java classes, 169 UI components, 108 test files, 37 migrations, 31 versions, v1.0.2 release.
svg.desc: A dark terminal page: how Campus syncs, from the host computer through an HTTPS tunnel to phones that keep working offline, and git log --graph of the latest Campus commits typing itself out.

g.text: A site and an app for one study group:
homework, a schedule from an .ics file, news
and files. It lives on the group leader's own
computer, and every phone keeps a copy that
syncs when the host is back on.
